c74object.name: bbb.dmx.fixturemap
c74object.digest: Map fixture parameters into one or more DMX universes.
c74object.description: Loads a bbb.dmx patch JSON file, accepts fixture parameter and fixture-aware tracking messages, and outputs 512-channel DMX universe lists. It can output one selected universe or all known universes.

inlets.inlet: Patch loading and fixture parameter input.

outlets.outlet: DMX data. In single-universe mode this is a 512-value list. In all-universe mode this is universe id followed by 512 values.

method.name: read
method.description: Read a bbb.dmx patch JSON file immediately. Relative paths are resolved by Max against the patch/search path.

method.name: bang
method.description: Output the current DMX frame.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clear the current output frame to defaults.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reload the current patch JSON file.

method.name: reset
method.description: Reset loaded fixture channels to profile defaults.

method.name: bangall
method.description: Output all known universes as universe id followed by 512 DMX values.

method.name: set
method.description: Set one or more 8-bit, 16-bit, or 24-bit fixture parameter values. Use repeated parameter/value pairs, or parameter pan_tilt with pan and tilt u16 values for paired movement.

method.name: setall
method.description: Apply one or more parameter/value pairs to every fixture in the loaded patch. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: nset
method.description: Set one or more normalized 0..1 fixture parameter values.

method.name: nsetall
method.description: Apply one or more normalized 0..1 parameter/value pairs to every fixture in the loaded patch. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: color
method.description: Set one fixture by semantic RGB color. Use rgb for normalized 0..1 values or rgb8 for 0..255 values; RGB/RGBW/CMY profiles are mapped automatically.

method.name: colorall
method.description: Apply one semantic RGB color to every supported color fixture. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped.

method.name: shutter
method.description: Open or close one fixture by semantic shutter state. Use 1/open/on/true for open and 0/close/closed/off/false/blackout for close. Shutter/strobe shared channels are intentionally overwritten.

method.name: shutterall
method.description: Apply one semantic shutter state to every supported fixture. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped.

method.name: track
method.description: Track one mover fixture toward a world-space target using loaded fixture position, rotation, calibration, and profile pan/tilt ranges.

method.name: trackall
method.description: Track every mover fixture toward one world-space target. Non-mover fixtures are skipped unless track_strict is enabled.

method.name: trackrel
method.description: Track one mover using a vector relative to the fixture origin.

method.name: trackallrel
method.description: Track every mover using the same vector relative to each fixture origin.

method.name: trackreset
method.description: Clear stored pan-continuity history for one fixture, or for all fixtures when no id is supplied.

method.name: ptbytes
method.description: Patch movertrack pan/tilt byte output into a fixture using that fixture profile's byte order.

attribute.name: patch
attribute.description: Patch JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Attribute loading is deferred; use the read message for immediate explicit loading.

attribute.name: universe
attribute.description: Selected output universe for single-universe output.

attribute.name: universe_mode
attribute.description: Output mode: selected outputs a bare 512-value list; all outputs universe id plus 512 values.

attribute.name: autobang
attribute.description: When non-zero, output automatically after parameter changes.

attribute.name: tracking_mode
attribute.description: Pan continuity mode for track and trackall messages: smart, pan, or off.

attribute.name: default_pan_range
attribute.description: Fallback pan range in degrees when the fixture profile omits pan.range_degrees.

attribute.name: default_tilt_range
attribute.description: Fallback tilt range in degrees when the fixture profile omits tilt.range_degrees.

attribute.name: track_strict
attribute.description: When non-zero, trackall reports non-mover fixtures as errors instead of skipping them.

attribute.name: color_use_white
attribute.description: When non-zero, semantic color extracts RGBW white from min(red, green, blue). When zero, RGBW white is left untouched and RGB channels carry the full color.
